categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the paper-based printing and packaging industry. Main products include folding cartons, gift boxes, corrugated boxes, paper pulp molded products, labels, and promotional tools. The company provides comprehensive printing packaging solutions including package design innovation, product design, material selection, production processing, and quality inspection services to customers in fast-moving consumer goods and consumer electronics sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed three major production platforms: high-speed digital printing platform for small-batch, multi-batch production with rapid delivery; flat printing and supporting post-processing platform for products with rich surface effects; and flexographic integrated production platform for large-batch, scaled production. Core technologies include intelligent manufacturing technology, digital printing technology, color management technology, network printing technology, green environmental protection packaging materials, and green production technology. The company holds over 400 authorized patents.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves customers in multiple industries including cosmetics, oral care, personal and household care, food, health supplements, pharmaceuticals, consumer electronics, tobacco products, and alcoholic beverages. Primary customers are well-known domestic and international brands and industry leaders in fast-moving consumer goods and consumer electronics sectors. The company's top five customers accounted for 40.34% of annual sales revenue in 2024.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates production bases across multiple regions in China including Zhongshan, Tianjin, Kunshan, Pinghu, Shenyang, Wuhan, Chengdu, and Guizhou, covering South China, North China, East China, Northeast, Central China, and Southwest regions. The company also has an overseas production base in Vietnam. Domestic sales accounted for 95.84% of revenue while exports represented 4.16% in 2024.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as a midstream to downstream manufacturer in the supply chain. It sources raw materials (primarily white board paper and white card paper) from suppliers, manufactures finished printing and packaging products, and sells directly to brand companies and consumer goods manufacturers. The company also provides supply chain management services including VMI and JIT business models.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus is 'Innovation-led, Smart Manufacturing-supported' with emphasis on: (1) developing eco-friendly and sustainable packaging solutions including microfilm-free environmental packaging, paper-based flexible buffer packaging, and degradable high-barrier paper packaging; (2) advancing intelligent manufacturing and digital transformation; (3) expanding product portfolio including pulp molded products, labels, and alcohol packaging; (4) multi-regional layout and localized production; (5) pursuing green development and carbon neutrality goals. R&D investment in 2024 was 108.05 million yuan, representing 3.88% of revenue.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of paper-based printing and packaging products. Revenue is recognized when customers take control of goods, typically upon delivery and customer acceptance. The company operates on a direct sales model with no intermediaries. Payment terms generally range from 30 to 180 days after product delivery. Other business revenue includes logistics and supply chain management services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company ranked 11th among China's top 100 printing and packaging enterprises in 2024 according to Printing Manager magazine. The company positions itself as a leading 'smart manufacturing' provider in the paper-based printing packaging industry for fast-moving consumer goods and consumer electronics. The company competes through differentiation in design innovation, intelligent manufacturing capabilities, quality management, and comprehensive service solutions rather than price competition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of 2.78 billion yuan (up 7.30% year-over-year) and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of 143.60 million yuan (down 29.60% year-over-year). Total assets reached 4.35 billion yuan at year-end 2024. The company has shown steady growth trajectory with revenue increasing from 2.47 billion yuan in 2022 to 2.78 billion yuan in 2024. The company is in a growth stage with significant capital expenditure plans.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) comprehensive integrated solutions combining creative design, material selection, intelligent manufacturing, and quality assurance; (2) advanced intelligent manufacturing capabilities and multi-regional production network enabling rapid, localized delivery; (3) strong R&D and design innovation with 400+ patents and 100+ design team members; (4) commitment to green and sustainable packaging solutions aligned with environmental regulations; (5) long-term partnerships with leading global brands providing stability and market insights; (6) superior quality management systems including ISO9001, ISO14001, ISO45001, FSC, and BRCGS certifications.
